articles.description: PM Narendra Modi, who is on a three-day visit to the Philippines, said he felt "very blessed" to visit the over a century-old Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan in Manila

articles.headline: India plans four-pacercorps for opening Test against New Zealand
articles.title: IND vs NZ Tests: India set to unleash four-pronged pace attack
articles.summary: Captain Shubman Gill confirmed that the visiting team will deploy four frontline fast bowlers for the opening Test match against New Zealand beginning in Wellington on November 19, 2026. Jasprit Bumrah will lead the pace attack alongside Mohammed Siraj, while the team finalises remaining selections to handle pitch conditions and strong winds during the two-match series opener.
articles.description: The nature of the Basin Reserve surface and the demands of bowling in Wellington’s notorious winds have added to the selection conundrum

articles.headline: Calcutta High Court initiates criminal contempt proceedings against Abhishek Banerjee
articles.title: Calcutta High Court issues criminal contempt proceedings against Abhishek Banerjee
articles.summary: The Calcutta High Court initiated criminal contempt proceedings against Trinamool Congress leader and parliamentarian Abhishek Banerjee following remarks and social media posts that allegedly scandalised the judiciary. Justice Krishna Rao directed the Diamond Harbour MP to explain within fifteen days why appropriate action should not be taken against him over statements made regarding protection and election outcomes.
articles.description: Justice Krishna Rao had said that by his remarks on November 7, Abhishek Banerjee had committed criminal contempt of the court” and “attempted with interference of administration of justice

articles.headline: Supreme Court Bar Association seeks contempt action against lawyer over derogatory remarks
articles.title: SCBA seeks contempt action against lawyer for derogatory remarks about CJI
articles.summary: The Supreme Court Bar Association informed the Supreme Court on November 17, 2026, that it intends to pursue contempt proceedings against a lawyer who made derogatory remarks about Chief Justice of India Surya Kant. Association representatives stated that the attorney general granted statutory consent for the petition. The chief justice agreed to list the matter for November 18 upon completion of procedural requirements.
articles.description: The office bearers urged the court to tag the petition along with pending contempt pleas against journalist Nikhil Wagle and Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Raut

articles.headline: Irish boxer Lee Reeves dies at thirty one following bout injuries
articles.title: Irish ‌‌‌‌boxer Lee Reeves, 31, dies three months after sustaining injuries
articles.summary: Irish boxer Lee Reeves passed away at thirty one after spending three months in a medically induced coma following a knockout defeat to Gary Cully in Dublin. The athlete underwent surgery after the August bout and reportedly contracted an infection prior to his death on Monday. His promotion company, Queensberry, confirmed the news while family members, coaches and opponents paid tribute.
articles.description: Lee Reeves died in Limerick three months after sustaining serious injuries in his bout against Gary Cully in Dublin.

articles.headline: Israel restricts aid entry as winter storms batter Gaza
articles.title: Who can force Israel to implement Gaza ceasefire deal?
articles.summary: Palestinians in Gaza face harsh winter weather in tents without basic services while Israel restricts humanitarian aid entry. Calls from the United Nations, European Union and the US-established Board of Peace have gone unanswered, leaving displaced families vulnerable to flooding and cold conditions, according to the report.
articles.description: Storms batter Palestinian territory as Israel restricts entry of aid.

articles.headline: Caste and political rivalries emerge ahead of elections
articles.title: Caste, old rivalries and Uttarakhand’s shadow on U.P. Assembly poll
articles.summary: Recent verbal exchanges between Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and Samajwadi Party President Akhilesh Yadav highlight critical caste and political equations connecting Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand. Carved out in 2000 under Bharatiya Janata Party rule, Uttarakhand is scheduled to hold legislative assembly elections alongside Uttar Pradesh during the February to March 2027 electoral cycle.
articles.description: By invoking the Rajput connection, CM Adityanath has inadvertently brought alive memories of a past when it suited the interests of the two parties to keep the Congress out

articles.headline: South Korea cracks down on AI exam cheating after top scorer confession
articles.title: South Korea cheating scandal: Are AI smart glasses a threat to exams?
articles.summary: South Korean authorities are tightening security measures for annual college entrance exams following an online confession by a top-scoring student who used artificial intelligence and a miniature camera to cheat. Prime Minister Han Seok-sook called an emergency meeting to address the scandal, prompting the Ministry of Education to announce strict eyewear inspections and potential criminal penalties for future offenders.
articles.description: A student with near-perfect scores on two tests has confessed to using artificial intelligence.

articles.headline: Baidu CEO warns of artificial intelligence bubble ahead of APEC meetings
articles.title: Head of China’s Baidu warns of AI ‘bubble’ ahead of APEC talks
articles.summary: Chinese technology giant Baidu Chief Executive Officer Robin Li stated that artificial intelligence adoption has failed to boost profits for most companies, raising concerns about a potential market bubble. Speaking in Shenzhen during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation meeting, Mr. Li noted that application-layer penetration has fallen short of expectations amid ongoing global industry challenges and broader financial risks.
articles.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping is due to hold talks with U.S. counterpart Donald Trump on Thursday during APEC

articles.headline: Congress criticizes Census 2027 process as a farce
articles.title: Census 2027 turning out to be farce: Congress
articles.summary: The Indian National Congress criticized the Census 2027 process on November 17, 2026, citing grave implications over data collection procedures. Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh highlighted that the self-enumeration portal briefly listed sects and spiritual figures among religious categories before removal, while also noting the absence of proper dropdown menus for non-scheduled castes.
articles.description: Census 2027 is turning out to be a farce in many respects. This will have grave implications, Jairam Ramesh said

articles.headline: Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal
articles.title: Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What you need to know
articles.summary: A weather system intensified into Cyclonic Storm Akvan over the Bay of Bengal on November 16, 2026, moving towards Andhra Pradesh, according to the Indian Meteorological Department. The storm is forecast to become a very severe cyclonic storm before crossing the coast on November 20. Heavy rainfall warnings were issued for coastal Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, West Bengal, and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, prompting authorities to halt marine operations.
articles.description: Cyclone Akvan may intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026)

articles.headline: AI models abandon climate facts to please users, UNESCO report finds
articles.title: AI models abandon climate facts to please users, UNESCO report finds
articles.description: AI models abandon climate facts to agree with users in eight out of 10 tests.

articles.headline: North Korean leader visits ski resort while Donald Trump hints at meeting
articles.title: North Korea’s Kim visits ski resort as Donald Trump hints at possible meeting
articles.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un visited a northern tourist zone near the Chinese border, according to state media reports released by the official Korean Central News Agency. Meanwhile, United States President Donald Trump suggested a possible meeting with Mr. Kim during a diplomatic tour, though regional experts indicate no visible preparations for such discussions are currently underway.
articles.description: We may meet with Kim Jong Un also, so that'll be good, Donald Trump told reporters

articles.headline: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled
articles.title: Africa CDC says Ebola outbreak in DR Congo ‘still not under control’
articles.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to battle an uncontrolled Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, recording over 11,200 cases and 5,500 deaths since May. Africa CDC director-general Jean Kaseya stated that delayed detection, conflict and a funding shortfall have hindered containment efforts, though the World Health Organization is advancing clinical trials.
articles.description: 'If we don't stop this outbreak now, it would be the worst Ebola outbreak,' Africa ​CDC director says.

articles.headline: Andy Burnham says Brexit is what the UK’s ‘enemies’ wanted
articles.title: Andy Burnham says Brexit is what the UK’s ‘enemies’ wanted
articles.description: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham slammed Brexit in a speech at the Lord Mayor’s Banquet.

articles.headline: Microsoft infrastructure issue causes worldwide Microsoft 365 and Outlook outages
articles.title: How does India address service outages?
articles.summary: An unspecific network upgrade failure within Microsoft infrastructure impacted global access to productivity tools like Microsoft 365 and Outlook between November 12 and November 13, 2026. Indian carriers including IndiGo, Akasa Air, and Air India experienced email support disruptions and rerouting as a consequence of the technical fault, according to company statements released on November 17, 2026.
articles.description: Does Indian law require Microsoft to have reported the recent outage that affected customers’ ability to access its productivity suite? What rules apply in such situations and what are their shortcomings in the present form? How are cloud companies accountable in other countries? What are Indian customers’ options?

articles.headline: U.S. lawmakers and officials welcome court ruling on visa fee
articles.title: U.S. lawmakers welcome court order scrapping $100,000 H-1B visa fee
articles.summary: United States lawmakers and state officials welcomed a federal court order striking down a $100,000 fee on H-1B visa applications on June 9, 2026. Massachusetts federal judge Leo Sorokin ruled the fee unlawful for lacking congressional approval, following a lawsuit led by California Attorney General Rob Bonta. White House spokesperson Taylor Rogers indicated the administration plans to appeal the decision in an appellate court.
articles.description: Republican lawmakers focused on H-1B visas for healthcare workers and teachers who are in short supply particularly in rural areas, rather than on the IT sector, which benefits from this visa category

articles.headline: Ukraine President Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink speed restrictions
articles.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that military satellite internet speeds remain restricted, hindering efforts to intercept Russian attacks. Speaking on Sunday, Zelensky said terminals operated by Elon Musk's Starshield system lost connection at speeds exceeding 161km/h. Meanwhile, regional officials reported ongoing Russian strikes resulting in multiple fatalities across Ukrainian regions including Chernihiv and Luhansk, while Ukraine launched retaliatory drone attacks on industrial sites in Russia.
articles.description: The Ukrainian president says the slowed-down internet is making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

articles.headline: Software bug at JPMorgan Chase causes banking transaction delays
articles.title: What to know about the online banking delays affecting major U.S. banks
articles.summary: A technical hardware issue at JPMorgan Chase created widespread transaction delays across major American financial systems and Zelle on Monday. The bank stated that the internal software bug was not a cyberattack and assured customers that funds remained accessible while engineers worked to restore normal operations before the end of the day.
articles.description: Chase said that the technical problem was not the result of a cyberattack, stressing that it was an isolated incident and not related to anything other than a bug.

articles.headline: US Congress considers stricter AI chip export rules after Nvidia scandal
articles.title: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
articles.summary: Lawmakers from both parties are pursuing stricter export rules on artificial intelligence chips following a scandal involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy. Senate leaders and House Speaker Mike Johnson have called for congressional testimony and renewed support for legislative measures limiting chip exports to China.
articles.description: Unsurprisingly, following the scandal involving now-former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy, Congress is looking to further restrict exports of AI chips. Both Democrats and Republicans have voiced support for various measures and bills that would tighten rules and have demanded that Huang and other Nvidia leaders testify before Congress. Senate Minority […]

articles.headline: UEFA backs French Football Federation chief Philippe Diallo against Gianni Infantino
articles.title: UEFA backs France's Diallo to stand against Infantino in FIFA election
articles.summary: European football governing body UEFA announced on November 16, 2026, its unanimous backing for French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo to contest the upcoming FIFA presidential election. Diallo accepted the invitation to challenge incumbent Gianni Infantino at the congress scheduled for March 18, 2027, in Rabat. The European association previously expressed strong opposition to Infantino regarding controversial governance proposals.
articles.description: UEFA had been struggling to find a credible candidate to stand against Gianni Infantino in the election, which will take place at the FIFA Congress on March 18 next year

articles.headline: Gas leak at ONGC well in Andhra Pradesh triggers evacuations
articles.title: Gas leak at ONGC well in Andhra’s Konaseema; residents within 1 km alerted, road closed
articles.summary: Authorities evacuated residents within a one-kilometre radius after a natural gas leak occurred during drilling at an Oil and Natural Gas Corporation well near Nagaram village on November 17, 2026. Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu directed officials to ensure public safety and deploy specialised technical teams to cap the well, while traffic on nearby roads was blocked as a precaution against potential hazards.
articles.description: There is no blowout or fire so far, officials say; experts are on their way to plug the leak

articles.headline: Two people killed in two-storey building collapse in Delhi
articles.title: Two killed, four injured as building collapses in Delhi’s Jwala Nagar
articles.summary: A three-year-old girl and a thirty-year-old man died while four other tenants sustained injuries following the collapse of a two-storey residential building in east Delhi on November 17, 2026. Police personnel and emergency services rescued all trapped occupants from the debris in the Jwala Nagar area, transporting them to Hedgewar Hospital for medical treatment while an investigation commenced.
articles.description: A three-year-old girl among the deceased; six tenants rescued from the debris and taken to Hedgewar Hospital

articles.headline: Quad leaders gather in Manila for strategic Indo-Pacific summit
articles.title: What is Quad, what is on the Manila agenda, and why does the 2026 summit matter?
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will join leaders from the United States, Japan, and Australia in Manila on November 17, 2026, for the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue summit. The meeting will address critical mineral supply chains, commercial shipping security, and regional stability in the Indo-Pacific, marking the first time the summit is hosted by a non-member nation.
articles.description: The summit in Manila will be the first meeting of Quad leaders since they gathered in Wilmington, United States, in September 2024

articles.headline: Inside the Chinese 'AI wonderland' where Xi will host Trump
articles.title: Inside the Chinese 'AI wonderland' where Xi will host Trump
articles.description: The meeting will take place as Trump attends the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation (Apec) summit in the southern city of Shenzhen.

articles.headline: Wayanad selected to host India mountain ecology congress
articles.title: Wayanad set to host Processual Mountains, India’s first mountain ecology congress
articles.summary: Researchers, policymakers, and indigenous communities will gather in Wayanad for India's first mountain ecology congress from December 10 to 12, 2026. Organised by the Hume Centre for Ecology and Wildlife Biology and the Kerala Veterinary and Animal Sciences University at Pookode, the event will address ecological vulnerability, disaster management, and sustainable development across mountain regions.
articles.description: Event brings together researchers, policymakers, indigenous communities and mountain practitioners to discuss the changing ecology, cultures and future of mountain regions

articles.headline: Rohit Pawar questions Devendra Fadnavis over VSR Ventures links
articles.title: Ajit Pawar plane crash: Rohit Pawar questions CM Devendra Fadnavis’ links with VSR Ventures
articles.summary: Nationalist Congress Party Sharad Pawar faction leader Rohit Pawar alleged on November 16, 2026, that Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis is protecting VSR Ventures, the aviation firm linked to the plane crash that killed former Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar. Bharatiya Janata Party leaders dismissed the claims as politically motivated publicity stunts and defended the Chief Minister against the accusations.
articles.description: Presenting a 49-page slideshow containing photographs, videos, flight records and documents, Mr. Pawar questioned why an FIR had not been registered in Maharashtra despite repeated complaints and why the investigation had not been handed over to the CBI

articles.headline: Software bug at JPMorgan Chase disrupts US banking transactions
articles.title: US bank outage: What caused Chase problems and Zelle payment delays?
articles.summary: Thousands of customers across the United States experienced transaction disruptions and service delays on November 16, 2026, following a software bug in an internal hardware system at JPMorgan Chase. The technical issue affected major financial institutions including Bank of America and Wells Fargo, while also causing payment delays on the Zelle platform before normal processing resumed.
articles.description: A Chase software bug disrupted US banking transactions and delayed some Zelle payments. Here's what happened.

articles.headline: Foreign portfolio investors record massive ₹89,856-crore equity surge
articles.title: What’s behind the record ₹89,856-crore FPI surge into Indian equities? | Explained
articles.summary: Foreign portfolio investors have reversed a two-year exit trend by injecting a record ₹89,856 crore into Indian equities in November 2026. Despite ongoing geopolitical tensions and valuation concerns, investors seeking safer alternatives have shifted capital away from tech-heavy markets like the United States, South Korea, and Taiwan due to a recent slowdown in global artificial intelligence stocks.
articles.description: The recent slowdown in AI stocks and concerns about their growth prospects have brought investors seeking a safer bet back to India

articles.headline: Central Empowered Committee report threatens Keralam river sand mining plans
articles.title: CEC report may complicate Keralam’s plan to resume river sand mining
articles.summary: A panel report advising a three-year phase-out of active river channel extraction could disrupt Keralam state efforts to lift a ten-year ban and extract 1.7 crore tonnes of sand from fourteen rivers. While Revenue Minister A.P. Anilkumar dismissed concerns, experts warn that apex court adoption of these measures would force significant revisions to the proposed extraction initiative aimed at flood mitigation.
articles.description: Keralam’s bid to end decade-long ban on river sand mining is on a collision course with a report by the SC-appointed Central Empowered Committee, which recommended a three-year roadmap to phase out unsustainable sand extraction from active river channels across the country

articles.headline: Kerala orders corruption probe against former sports minister
articles.title: Messi visit row: Keralam govt orders probe against former Sports Minister V. Abdurahiman
articles.summary: The government initiated an investigation under the Prevention of Corruption Act against former Sports Minister V. Abdurahiman regarding irregularities in Lionel Messi's proposed visit. Led by the Special Investigation Team, the inquiry follows the Governor's approval. Officials allege the minister abused his position to benefit event sponsors while bypassing established departmental procedures.
articles.description: Development comes close on the heels of Governor’s approval for prosecuting Abdurahiman in the case

articles.headline: West Bengal minister acknowledges internal party violence
articles.title: West Bengal BJP supporters beating up own party members, says Union Minister as feuds rise in party
articles.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party Union Minister of State Shantanu Thakur publicly acknowledged internal factionalism in West Bengal, alleging that party members are physically attacking each other. The remarks follow the death of Arup Saha in Panihati after an attack by a mob allegedly including party supporters, amid rising tensions between long-term members and former Trinamool Congress members.
articles.description: “BJP workers are being beaten up, and those beating them are also from the BJP. The police administration has turned a blind eye and is not functioning impartially,” alleged Bongaon MP Santanu Thakur

articles.headline: Jimmy Tata supports Tata Sons listing amid internal power struggle
articles.title: Jimmy Tata backs Tata Sons listing, accuses Noel of ‘back-door takeover’
articles.summary: Jimmy Naval Tata has publicly backed the listing of Tata Sons, citing the need for greater accountability and transparency. He accused Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata of attempting a back-door takeover by consolidating family control. Jimmy Tata urged the Reserve Bank of India to enforce listing timelines to prevent the group's potential breakup.
articles.description: He urged the RBI to enforce strict listing timelines and prevent any breakup of the group, while calling on the government and Charity Commissioner to safeguard the trusts’ founding objectives.

articles.headline: Government removes controversial religious classification drop-down menu from Census portal
articles.title: ‘ISKCON’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Gorak Nath’: 287 ‘other’ religions briefly listed on Census portal
articles.summary: The Union Ministry of Home Affairs removed a drop-down menu containing 287 religious categories from the Census 2027 self-enumeration portal on November 16, 2026. The portal had launched in Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Goa, and Punjab. A government official stated the list was intended as predictive text to help enumerators avoid spelling errors, while critics noted the entries included major sects and movements.
articles.description: The drop-down menu under the ‘Others’ category in the question pertaining to the respondent’s religion had 287 options for those not choosing from among the six major religions in India. After The Hindu raised a query about the classification, the drop-down menu was removed from the portal.

articles.headline: Vance says he will decide on 2028 presidential run next year
articles.title: Vance says he will decide 'sometime next year' about 2028 US presidential run
articles.summary: United States Vice-President JD Vance announced during a Fox News interview that he will determine whether to launch a presidential campaign in 2028 sometime next year. Vance stated he is in no rush to finalise his plans, though allies expect a run. The timing comes as Republicans navigate the fallout from the midterm elections and discussions regarding potential primary contenders including Marco Rubio and Ron DeSantis.
articles.description: The US vice-president tells Fox News that when he makes a decision to run or otherwise, he will "be all in on whatever that decision is".

articles.headline: Government raises export duties on diesel and aviation turbine fuel
articles.title: Export duty on diesel hiked ₹2.5/litre, ATF ₹1.5/litre, petrol remains nil
articles.summary: India increased the export duty on diesel and aviation turbine fuel by 2.5 rupees and 1.5 rupees per litre respectively, while keeping petrol levies at nil. According to the government, the fortnightly review aims to protect domestic retail availability amid the West Asian conflict. Diesel exports face a levy of 14 rupees per litre, and aviation turbine fuel reaches 12.5 rupees per litre.
articles.description: The hike in diesel levy assumes added significance as India looks to further up their exports of the vehicular fuel to Europe amid a global supply crunch.

articles.headline: Alaska Senate voting data questions claims of voter confusion over candidates
articles.title: Trump says Alaska voters chose the wrong Dan Sullivan. What does the data show?
articles.summary: With ninety-eight percent of votes counted in Alaska's delayed midterm Senate race, Democratic candidate Mary Peltola leads incumbent Republican Senator Dan S Sullivan. Voting data analyzed by BBC Verify shows that over a third of voters ranking a second candidate named Daniel J Sullivan Jr first left their second choice blank, while nearly twice as many voters ranked Peltola second instead of the incumbent.
articles.description: Votes are still being counted in the Alaska Senate race, with Democrat Mary Peltola ahead of Republican incumbent Senator Dan S Sullivan.

articles.headline: Allies of former Nvidia boss Jensen Huang campaign for his reinstatement
articles.title: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex boss
articles.summary: Supporters including Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney are lobbying for Jensen Huang to return as Nvidia chief executive following his resignation last week. Huang stepped down after reports of two extramarital affairs, one involving an alleged Chinese spy. While shareholders and executives seek his return, the board faces pressure to maintain leadership stability during ongoing investigations.
articles.description: A number of tech figures have backed an effort asking the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.

articles.headline: Irish court jails Dublin knife attacker for life
articles.title: Irish court jails man for life over Dublin knife attack that sparked riots
articles.summary: Riad Bouchaker was sentenced to life imprisonment at the Central Criminal Court in Dublin on November 16, 2026, for attempting to murder three children and assaulting childcare worker Leanne Flynn during a November 23, 2023, knife attack. The brutal incident outside a school severely injured the young victims and sparked severe rioting in the Irish capital driven by online misinformation regarding the attacker's identity and immigration status.
articles.description: Three children and a woman were injured in the attack outside a central Dublin school in 2023.

articles.headline: Rahul Gandhi tells Supreme Court Election Commission produced no proof on decision
articles.title: No proof from ECI to show SIR was a ‘unanimous’ decision, Rahul Gandhi to Supreme Court
articles.summary: Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi submitted to the Supreme Court on November 16, 2026, that the Election Commission of India failed to prove its special intensive revision was a unanimous decision by top commissioners. Represented by senior advocates, Gandhi argued that missing minutes and independent communications by commissioners contradict claims of unanimous functioning. The case is scheduled for a November 17 hearing before a bench headed by Chief Justice Surya Kant.
articles.description: The ECI’s October 26 affidavit, in response to a petition filed by INDIA bloc leaders led by Mr. Gandhi, denied any differences of opinion between the CEC and the Election Commissioners over the SIR process

articles.headline: Clashes between regional forces in Moyale disrupt daily life and trade
articles.title: Ethiopia Moyale clashes disrupt livelihoods as territorial dispute deepens
articles.summary: Fighting involving police and armed groups from Ethiopia's Oromia and Somali regional administrations has disrupted livelihoods and transport in the southern Borana Zone. The escalation began on October 18 after a Somali regional office opened in Moyale. Kenya reported that approximately 40,000 Ethiopians crossed the border, while analysts highlighted unresolved territorial boundaries and historical land disputes as root causes.
articles.description: The country's unresolved Oromia-Somali border dispute fuels renewed violence, displacing thousands.

articles.headline: Millions of Nigerian children lack access to education due to crises
articles.title: BBC launches programme for children forced from school by bandits and poverty in West Africa
articles.summary: Nearly nineteen million school-age children in Nigeria are currently missing out on formal education, according to 2024 Unesco figures. In regions like Goronyo, displaced youths face extreme poverty, child marriage and armed violence from criminal gangs known as bandits. In response, the BBC World Service launched Dars Hausa to deliver remote lessons, while education officials acknowledge historical funding gaps and infrastructural challenges.
articles.description: The new show brings English, maths and science lessons to children via TV, radio and social media.

articles.headline: Former Paraguay president transferred to military prison amid public backlash
articles.title: Paraguay ex-president moved to military jail amid special treatment reports
articles.summary: Santiago Pena was moved to Vinas Cue military prison on Judge Osmar Legal's orders after reports revealed he received special amenities at his previous detention site. Pena faces corruption charges related to the collapse of Ueno Bank, which held roughly 850 million dollars in public funds. Following his removal from office on November 6, Pedro Alliana was sworn in as president.
articles.description: Santiago Pena has been accused of corruption following the collapse of Ueno Bank earlier this month.

articles.headline: Bharatiya Janata Party leaders hold strategy meeting in Mathura for polls
articles.title: BJP holds key party meeting in Mathura for Assembly polls
articles.summary: Senior leaders of the Bharatiya Janata Party, including Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and state president Pankaj Chaudhary, met at the Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Cow Research Institute in Mathura to discuss electoral strategy for upcoming assembly elections. Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya stated that constructing a grand temple at Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi will be a major campaign issue for the 2027 elections.
articles.description: The party announced the meeting to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and public welfare benefits, while also outlining electoral strategy and caste-based outreach

articles.headline: Indian AI start-ups develop tools for local infrastructure challenges
articles.title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records
articles.summary: Indian entrepreneurs are leveraging artificial intelligence to build downstream consumer applications addressing local challenges, including land records, road maintenance, and healthcare support. Despite raising over one billion dollars, founders encounter significant obstacles, such as severe shortages of high-end graphics processing units, high infrastructure costs, and complex regulatory environments that hinder commercialisation.
articles.description: From legal-tech to healthcare, dozens of Indian AI start-ups are solving uniquely Indian challenges.

articles.headline: Shenzhen showcases advanced artificial intelligence alongside economic anxieties for workers
articles.title: China is hosting the world's leaders in its AI wonderland. Here's what they won't see
articles.summary: Shenzhen is hosting global leaders for an economic summit while highlighting China's rapid advancements in artificial intelligence and humanoid robotics. While young engineers celebrate technological innovation in the city, many local workers and business owners face economic pressures from a stagnant property market, relocating factories, and rising living costs. The BBC explored both the high-tech prosperity and the widespread financial uncertainty among ordinary residents.
articles.description: Leave Shenzhen's tech-flecked city skyline and you run into the challenges confronting Xi's China.

articles.headline: Pentagon denies allegations linking Deputy Defense Secretary to Goldman Sachs banker
articles.title: US Pentagon rejects allegations linking deputy to a Goldman Sachs banker
articles.summary: The Pentagon dismissed Bloomberg reports claiming Deputy Defense Secretary Steve Feinberg pressured defense contractors Lockheed Martin and RTX to work with banker Jim Donovan. Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell called the allegations baseless, stating Feinberg maintains no favorites. The report had raised conflict of interest concerns regarding lucrative military negotiations involving multibillion-dollar missile contracts.
articles.description: Pentagon defends Steve Feinberg, amid claims in Bloomberg he encouraged defence contractors to use a specific banker.

articles.headline: Major United States banks report online account access issues for customers
articles.title: Customers at some of the U.S.’ largest banks are reporting difficulty accessing accounts online
articles.summary: Customers across the United States experienced technical difficulties accessing online accounts for major financial institutions including Bank of America, Chase, J.P. Morgan, U.S. Bank, Wells Fargo, and Zelle. A Chase spokesperson confirmed the disruptions stemmed from a technical bug rather than a cyberattack, stating transactions were delayed while account access remained available to users.
articles.description: Bank of America, Chase, J.P. Morgan, U.S. Bank, Wells Fargo and Zelle were listed by users as down or experiencing issues, according to the website downdetector.com

articles.headline: Political protests erupt in Jammu and Kashmir following controversial remarks by leaders
articles.title: Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congress’ Karra, BJP’s Parihar spark protests in J&K
articles.summary: Demonstrations broke out across Jammu on November 17, 2026, after political figures traded accusations over the killing of two Special Police Officers in Kishtwar. Leaders from the Congress party and the Bharatiya Janata Party exchanged sharp criticisms regarding security forces and local mosques, prompting various religious and political organizations to demand public apologies and accountability for communal tensions.
articles.description: Mr. Karra said that “two SPOs were killed by the Army in a mistaken-identity case on November 11”, while senior BJP leader Sharma said, “Congress is spreading misleading information to shift blame from terrorists to security forces”

articles.headline: Germany defeats Netherlands five to zero to secure quarterfinal spot
articles.title: Germany thrash Netherlands to book Nations League quarterfinal spot
articles.summary: Jurgen Klopp managed a dominant five-goal victory over the Netherlands in Berlin on November 17, 2026, securing the top spot in UEFA Nations League Group A2. The heavy defeat eliminated the Dutch from first place, allowing Germany to advance to the quarterfinals alongside Greece and Serbia following standout performances from Derry Scherhant and Florian Wirtz.
articles.description: Jurgen Klopp's side outclasses the Dutch 5-0 in Berlin to secure top spot in UEFA Nations League Group A2.

articles.headline: Christian community seeks West Bengal chief minister intervention over rising church attacks
articles.title: Christian community seeks West Bengal CM’s intervention over targeted attacks ahead of Christmas
articles.summary: Christian representatives in West Bengal expressed serious safety concerns on November 17, 2026, regarding escalating violence against churches across multiple southern districts following the recent state election. Church leaders urged Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari to intervene while denying allegations of forced conversions made by Bharatiya Janata Party officials ahead of the upcoming Christmas holiday season.
articles.description: Bishop of Calcutta Reverend Paritosh Canning ruled out claims of religious conversion by institutions affiliated with the Churches of North India

articles.headline: Mamdani to disband NYPD unit deployed at Columbia protests
articles.title: Mamdani to disband NYPD unit deployed at Columbia protests
articles.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani says he is disbanding the NYPD’s Strategic Response Group or SRG.

articles.headline: BJP worker killed in West Bengal amid intra-party feud suspicions
articles.title: Murder of BJP worker by own party members sparks speculation of intra-party feud in West Bengal
articles.summary: An active Bharatiya Janata Party worker died on November 15, 2026, after sustaining injuries during a scuffle in Panihati, West Bengal, prompting local allegations of an internal feud involving former Trinamool Congress members. The altercation followed protests over a beaten businessman, drawing claims from local leaders that recently switched members caused the violence. Meanwhile, similar factional tensions emerged in Barrackpore against a local MLA.
articles.description: Following the death of Arup Saha, the husband of Ruma Saha — the secretary of BJP’s Panihati-1 mandal (zone), Panihati MLA Ratna Debnath said that she feels personally responsible for the death of the BJP worker

articles.headline: Forensic expert claims Jeffrey Epstein death was homicide
articles.title: Forensic expert says his analysis of autopsy photos suggests Epstein was killed
articles.summary: Professor Michael Freeman stated that the August 10, 2019, death of convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein in a New York prison was likely a homicide by strangulation. Freeman reviewed medical examiner files provided by Epstein's brother, Mark Epstein. Former chief medical examiner Dr Barbara Sampson previously ruled the death a suicide, a determination supported by a Department of Justice investigation.
articles.description: Professor Michael Freeman tells BBC Newsnight that he believes the convicted sex offender's injuries are consistent with a homicide.

articles.headline: Constellation Energy dismisses concerns over political data center opposition
articles.title: Big Nuclear isn’t worried about the Democrats stopping data centers
articles.summary: Constellation Energy Chief Executive Officer Joe Dominguez stated that market fears regarding Democratic opposition to data center development are overstated. During a third-quarter earnings call, the nuclear operator executive argued that lawmakers prioritize economic growth and construction jobs, even as federal and state discussions continue regarding energy demand, environmental regulations, and power grid infrastructure.
articles.description: Constellation Energy - America's largest operator of nuclear power plants - does not share Wall Street's concerns that the Democrats will slow down data center development. On the company's third-quarter earnings call last week, CEO Joe Dominguez was, for lack of a better word, unbothered as he addressed the blue wave. "I do think we've […]

articles.headline: UEFA backs Diallo to challenge Infantino for FIFA presidency
articles.title: UEFA backs Diallo to challenge Infantino for FIFA presidency
articles.description: UEFA has found its candidate to take on Gianni Infantino in next year’s FIFA presidential election

articles.headline: Rajasthan concludes four-phase panchayat elections with high turnout
articles.title: 70% turnout in most districts as four-phase panchayat polls end in Rajasthan
articles.summary: Rajasthan finished its four-phase panchayat elections on November 17, 2026, with voting exceeding 70 percent across 25 districts for thousands of posts. The final phase saw minor confrontations, ballot paper voting by over 1.05 crore eligible voters, and immediate vote counting. Officials detained several individuals following localized violence and disputes over fraudulent voting allegations.
articles.description: The declaration of results will bring the election of representatives in all 14,403 panchayats in the State to a close

articles.headline: El Nino impact drives record crop insurance registrations in Karnataka
articles.title: El Nino impact drives record surge in crop insurance registrations across Karnataka
articles.summary: Karnataka experienced a record surge in crop insurance registrations during Kharif 2026, reaching approximately 37.5 lakh farmers due to widespread agricultural losses from El Nino. Agriculture Minister P.M. Narendraswamy noted the historic turnout, while Union Minister Shobha Karandlaje raised concerns that private insurance companies frequently fail to provide farmers with their full compensation.

articles.headline: OpenAI launches classifier tool to detect child abuse deepfakes
articles.title: OpenAI wants to stop deepfakes from overwhelming child abuse tiplines
articles.summary: OpenAI introduced a new classifier tool designed to help investigators identify abusive imagery of children, including artificial intelligence-generated content. Announced at a Washington briefing on Monday, the system aims to reduce false positives for organizations like the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children while offering twenty-four-hour user access pauses and support resources for policy violations.
articles.description: OpenAI is announcing a tool that it says will help child sexual abuse investigators cut through the noise to find harmful material they can act on quickly. At a Monday press briefing in Washington, DC, OpenAI announced a classifier it says can better detect abusive imagery of kids, including whether it's AI-generated. It's also offering […]

articles.headline: IISc researchers combine antibiotics to tackle drug-resistant tuberculosis
articles.title: IISc researchers combine antibiotics to tackle drug-resistant TB
articles.summary: Indian Institute of Science researchers identified a strategy to reverse isoniazid resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis by combining it with vancomycin. Testing with clinical isolates and mouse models demonstrated a significant reduction in bacterial burden and lung granulomas. The team is currently working to advance this specific antibiotic combination toward clinical trials.

articles.headline: Customers across five major United States banks report online service outages
articles.title: Thousands report online banking outages at major US banks
articles.summary: Customers at five major financial institutions across the United States reported service disruptions on Monday, according to Downdetector. Affected banks included US Bank, Wells Fargo, Zelle, JPMorgan Chase, and Bank of America, with nearly 5,000 complaints recorded at Chase. A Chase spokesperson stated that technical issues caused transaction delays while ensuring customer funds remained secure, and sources indicated bad actors were not involved.
articles.description: Customers report online access issues at major US banks, including Chase, Wells Fargo and Bank of America.

articles.headline: Counter Intelligence Kashmir files charge sheet against six individuals in TRF terror funding case
articles.title: Chargesheet against six in conspiracy to raise funds for TRF: police
articles.summary: Counter Intelligence Kashmir filed a charge sheet on November 16, 2026, against six individuals accused of conspiring to raise and route funds for the banned outfit The Resistance Front. Authorities stated that three Srinagar residents received funds from a Pakistan-based operative during pilgrimages to Saudi Arabia, while three other co-accused remain absconding in Dubai, London, and Pakistan.
articles.description: Mukhtar Ahmad Baba, a TRF-linked terrorist operating from Pakistan, used hawala and other covert channels to send funds into J&K, CIK stated

articles.headline: Sonia Gandhi memoir sells over two lakh copies in under a week
articles.title: Sonia’s memoir ‘Belonging’ debuts with 2 lakh copies sold in under a week: HarperCollins India CEO
articles.summary: Congress leader Sonia Gandhi’s debut memoir titled Belonging: A Journey of Love sold over two lakh copies in less than a week following its release on November 10, 2026, according to HarperCollins India CEO Ananth Padmanabhan. Officially launched in New Delhi on November 16, 2026, the book broke multiple publishing records, becoming the fastest-selling non-fiction work and memoir in independent India.
articles.description: The thunderous response to the book has clearly taken even the debut author by surprise, with Sonia Gandhi admitting that she is “overwhelmed” by the outpouring of love and affection from readers

articles.headline: Madras High Court rules MLAs cannot threaten government officials
articles.title: MLAs cannot threaten government officials and browbeat them into submission: Madras High Court
articles.summary: The Madras High Court ruled on November 16, 2026, that members of the legislative assembly cannot threaten government officials or obstruct them from performing official duties. Justice V. Lakshminarayanan issued the observation while dismissing a petition by former Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam MLA C.V.M.P. Ezhilarasan to quash a criminal case filed against him for allegedly abusing an official in 2019.
articles.description: Justice V. Lakshminarayanan dismisses a plea by DMK former MLA C.M.P. Ezhilarasan to quash a case booked against him for threatening Kancheepuram Collector’s personal assistant

articles.headline: Open-source supporters circulate petition urging Jensen Huang to return as Nvidia CEO
articles.title: The open-source movement wants Jensen Huang back
articles.summary: Supporters of open-source artificial intelligence circulated a petition on November 13, 2026, demanding the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as chief executive officer of Nvidia. Prominent figures from Hugging Face and venture capital firms signed the appeal, aiming to retain Huang as a key policy defender as new US Department of Commerce rules and findings regarding Chinese startups threaten the movement.
articles.description: This story originally appeared in The Algorithm, our weekly newsletter on AI. To get stories like this in your inbox first, sign up here. On Friday, a petition to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia began circulating on social media, and by Monday it listed some notable signatories, including Elon Musk and several influential Nvidia…

articles.headline: Congress leader Ali Mehdi files Supreme Court petition over Mustafabad voter deletions
articles.title: Plea in SC says ghost Form 7s haunt Mustafabad constituency during Delhi SIR
articles.summary: Congress leader Ali Mehdi approached the Supreme Court on November 16, 2026, alleging widespread fraudulent Form 7 applications seeking voter deletions in Mustafabad. Filed through advocate Shariq Ahmed, the writ petition states that individuals listed as dead or permanently shifted were found alive at their recorded addresses, compromising electoral integrity ahead of the final Delhi roll publication.
articles.description: The petition said persons declared dead were alive, while persons said to have shifted were found at home. Thirty-seven applications examined by the authorities were found to be false or fabricated.

articles.headline: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen wins ten consecutive matches to claim two titles
articles.title: Lakshya Sen roars back to life
articles.summary: Indian badminton player Lakshya Sen secured ten consecutive victories in November 2026, capturing the Hylo Open and Kumamoto Masters Japan titles. His late-season resurgence included overcoming opponents in Germany and Japan. This winning streak marks a notable return to form for the athlete, whose campaign had previously appeared to be losing momentum before this successful international run.
articles.description: After months of frustration, tough losses and a season that threatened to slip away, the ace shuttler has found his mojo again, winning back-to-back titles at the Hylo Open and Japan Masters to boost his BWF World Tour Finals hopes

articles.headline: DVAC files criminal case and arrests publisher over book procurement irregularities in Tamil Nadu
articles.title: DVAC registers criminal case over alleged irregularities in the purchase of books
articles.summary: The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption registered a criminal case and arrested publisher R. Mohan on November 16, 2026, over corruption and forgery in public library book procurements. Investigators found that Akal Vizhakku Publishers and Phoenix Publications supplied substandard, plagiarized books written under fictitious names using ChatGPT, prompting raids across seven locations in Tamil Nadu.
articles.description: The criminal case has been registered against a Chennai-based publisher and “unidentified officials” of the Directorate of Public Libraries, Anna Centenary Library, Chennai, and Periyar Arivulagam, Coimbatore. On Monday (November 16, 2026), DVAC officials launched a search at seven places and seized receipt vouchers for book procurement and other documents. Mohan, proprietor of Akal Vizhakku Publishers, was arrested

articles.headline: Campaign to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO gains support
articles.title: Trump says ‘would not mind’ Huang being reinstated at Nvidia
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump and tech leaders including Elon Musk backed a petition to restore Jensen Huang as chief executive officer of Nvidia following his resignation amid a leadership controversy. An online petition gathered thousands of signatures from staff and investors, urging the board to bring back Mr. Huang while interim CEO Colette Kress manages operations ahead of the quarterly earnings call.
articles.description: Trump said Jensen Huang ‘learned a big lesson’ and he ‘would certainly not mind’ if he was reinstated, while adding that there’s a ‘big group of people that would like him to return’

articles.headline: Azam Khan tells Allahabad High Court his arrest was politically motivated
articles.title: ED’s arrest was politically motivated, Azam Khan tells Allahabad High Court
articles.summary: Former Uttar Pradesh minister and Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan argued before the Allahabad High Court that his October 31 arrest by the Enforcement Directorate was politically motivated to keep him imprisoned through the 2027 Assembly elections. Represented by senior advocate Kapil Sibal, the 78-year-old challenged the money-laundering case involving Mohammad Ali Jauhar University, while the agency defended its procedural actions before Justices Rajiv Gupta and Devendra Singh.
articles.description: Former Uttar Pradesh Minister and Samajwadi Party leader told the Court that the arrest was intended to keep him behind bars until the 2027 Assembly elections

articles.headline: CAG K. Sanjay Murthy highlights technology and reforms for accountability
articles.title: CAG focuses on technology, reforms to strengthen public accountability
articles.summary: Comptroller and Auditor General of India K. Sanjay Murthy emphasized the integration of artificial intelligence and cross-departmental reforms to enhance public accountability during the Audit Divas celebrations marking 166 years of the institution. Mr. Murthy stated that the organisation tabled 214 audit reports across union and state governments, launched pan-India horizontal audits on urban mobility and business reforms, and deployed artificial intelligence tools to streamline financial audits.
articles.description: Reforms in the last couple of years, including breaking departmental silos; auditing themes, including ‘Ease of Living’ and ‘Ease of Doing Business’; and focusing on local bodies, were aligned with the nation’s development goals, says K. Sanjay Murthy

articles.headline: U.S. report shows decline in Indian student enrolments for 2025-26
articles.title: Decline in number of Indian students studying in U.S.
articles.summary: Enrolments of Indian students in American universities fell by six percent to 339,435 during the 2025-26 academic year compared to the previous year, according to a report by the Institute of International Education. Despite the decline driven largely by visa application challenges and cost factors, India remains the leading source of international students in the United States, which hosted 1,146,163 foreign students overall.
articles.description: Despite the decline, India continues to send the largest chunk of international students to the US

articles.headline: CBI arrests two Narcotics Control Bureau officials in bribery case
articles.title: CBI arrests two NCB Sub-Inspectors in alleged ₹25-lakh bribery case
articles.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation arrested two Narcotics Control Bureau sub-inspectors, Ajit Singh Meena and Sumeet Kumar, on November 16, 2026, over an alleged extortion scheme involving a narcotics case. Following a complaint filed on November 14 regarding a demand of fifty lakh rupees to avoid false implication under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, the agency trapped the officers while accepting a partial payment of twelve lakh rupees.
articles.description: The accused have been identified as Ajit Singh Meena, posted as an Investigating officer; and Sumeet Kumar

articles.headline: Congress constitutes screening committees for upcoming assembly elections across five states
articles.title: Congress sets up screening panels for five poll-bound States; Maken to head U.P. committee
articles.summary: The Indian National Congress party announced screening panels on November 16, 2026, to oversee candidate selections for upcoming Assembly elections in Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Goa, and Manipur. Party leaders including Ajay Maken and Sirivella Prasad will head the state committees, which comprise appointed members and ex-officio officials to manage preparations for early next year elections.
articles.description: The appointments come ahead of the Election Commission’s announcement of the poll schedule

articles.headline: Sonia Gandhi launches memoir in New Delhi alongside opposition leaders
articles.title: Wanted to set the record straight, says Sonia Gandhi at official launch of memoir
articles.summary: Congress Parliamentary Party chairperson Sonia Gandhi released her book Belonging: A Journey of Love in New Delhi on November 16, 2026, joined by opposition leaders and her family. She stated the memoir was written to correct false accounts about her relatives, while Rahul Gandhi praised her resilience following the assassinations of Indira Gandhi and Rajiv Gandhi.
articles.description: Several INDIA bloc leaders, including Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav and TMC’s Abhishek Banerjee, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay and BJP leader Amarinder Singh attended the launch of Sonia Gandhi’s memoir on Monday, November 16

articles.headline: Silicon Valley figures and Elon Musk urge Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
articles.title: Musk, Silicon Valley insiders urge Nvidia to restore Jensen Huang as CEO
articles.summary: Tesla and SpaceX chief executive officer Elon Musk joined over 177000 signatories demanding Nvidia reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive officer following his resignation last week amid allegations of extramarital affairs. Meanwhile, United States President Donald Trump stated a return would be positive as the administration announced new restrictions on exporting advanced artificial intelligence chips to China.
articles.description: Nvidia faces a potential 30 percent value loss in value without Jensen Huang, market analysts say, amid a stock downturn.

articles.headline: Health department identifies thousands of pregnant women for cyclone evacuation
articles.title: 3,478 pregnant women identified for shifting to hospitals amid cyclone alert
articles.summary: The Department of Health, Medical and Family Welfare identified 3478 pregnant women due between November 14 and 24, 2026, for hospital transfers following a state cyclone alert. Health officials reported that 377 individuals have already been relocated, with medical teams and emergency facilities placed on standby across coastal areas to maintain healthcare services during worsening weather.

articles.headline: When will we see Robert Pattinson as Bond in cinemas?
articles.title: When will we see Robert Pattinson as Bond in cinemas?
articles.description: Robert Pattinson has been announced as the next James Bond, becoming the seventh actor to take up the mantle of 007.

articles.headline: Iraq orders military deployment into Kataib Hezbollah stronghold amid smuggling probe
articles.title: Iraq deploys army to stronghold of Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah
articles.summary: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi ordered armed forces to enter the town of Jurf al-Nasr and gave the Iran-backed group Kataib Hezbollah a deadline of Friday to evacuate the area amid a corruption and oil smuggling investigation. Government officials reported the crackdown follows intelligence findings of pipeline tampering, while the faction denied the allegations and dismissed the probe.
articles.description: US pressure on Iraq to curb Tehran's influence leaves potential for direct confrontation with Iran-linked armed group.

articles.headline: India and Egypt target twelve billion dollars in bilateral trade
articles.title: India and Egypt form working group to explore trade deal contours
articles.summary: India and Egypt agreed to establish a Joint Working Group to explore a preferential or free trade agreement aiming to nearly double bilateral commerce to twelve billion dollars. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal and Egyptian Minister Mohamed Farid Saleh co-chaired the Joint Trade Committee meeting in Cairo on November 15, 2026, where both nations discussed reducing non-tariff barriers, enhancing market access, and strengthening manufacturing investments across multiple priority sectors.
articles.description: During his ongoing visit to Egypt, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal co-chaired, along with Egypt’s Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade Mohamed Farid Saleh, the 7th session of the India-Egypt Joint Trade Committee (JTC) in Egypt’s New Administrative Capital.

articles.headline: Iran braces for severe winter natural gas shortages amid infrastructure damage
articles.title: Iran braces for natural gas shortages during winter energy imbalance
articles.summary: Authorities in Tehran warned that energy imbalances resulting from United States and Israeli military strikes could cause widespread winter fuel shortages across the country. Saeed Tavakoli, head of the National Iranian Gas Company, reported that projectile impacts knocked out significant production capacity. The crisis threatens household heating and industrial output, forcing power plants to burn polluting heavy oil alternatives.
articles.description: The gas infrastructure in Iran has suffered from underdevelopment and sanctions, and now damage from the war.

articles.headline: Israeli forces demolish the homes of two Palestinian prisoners
articles.title: Israeli forces demolish the homes of two Palestinian prisoners
articles.description: Israeli forces demolished the homes of two Palestinian prisoners as Al Jazeera’s Nida Ibrahim was reporting

articles.headline: Jerusalem Daily: Eisenkot wants Netanyahu out
articles.title: Jerusalem Daily: Eisenkot wants Netanyahu out
articles.description: Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot appears to be pushing to oust Benjamin Netanyahu as Prime Minister.

articles.headline: UEFA backs French federation chief Philippe Diallo for FIFA presidency
articles.title: UEFA backs France’s Philippe Diallo to challenge Infantino in FIFA election
articles.summary: European football governing body UEFA announced unanimous support for French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo to challenge incumbent Gianni Infantino in the March 2027 election. Diallo accepted the invitation after UEFA led opposition to Infantino regarding controversial investment proposals. The election will take place during the FIFA Congress in Rabat, Morocco, with candidate declarations closing on November 18.
articles.description: French Football Federation chief Diallo emerges as a strong challenger in FIFA's upcoming presidential election.

articles.headline: Saudi Arabia replaces military coalition commander following setbacks in Yemen
articles.title: After Yemen setback, Saudi Arabia replaces military commander
articles.summary: King Salman issued a royal decree appointing General Fayyad Al-Ruwaili as commander of the joint forces after allied Yemeni troops withdrew from strategic territories. The military changes followed rapid advances by Iran-allied Houthi forces near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, increasing security concerns around the government base in Aden. Analysts noted that fragmented leadership on the government side contributed to the recent territorial losses.
articles.description: The Houthis have made rapid gains ⁠against the Saudi-backed Yemeni government since the U.S.-Iran conflict reignited Yemen’s frozen civil war this summer, drawing Riyadh back into confrontation with the group

articles.headline: Security forces engage suspected terrorists during ongoing Kulgam search operation
articles.title: After daylong operation against terrorists in Kashmir’s Kulgam, searches on to trace the bodies
articles.summary: An encounter started in Kulgam on November 16, 2026, as security forces continued an anti-terror operation spanning six days. Police stated the area was cordoned off following initial reports suggesting individuals linked to a November 11 attack on the Central Reserve Police Force were trapped. The operation matters as authorities attempt to neutralize militants responsible for prior injuries to security personnel.
articles.description: LeT-affiliated local terrorist, accomplices behind November 11 attack may have been trapped by security operation; unconfirmed reports say the body of at least one terrorist with a rifle was spotted at the site

articles.headline: Israeli opposition leaders denounce alleged election framing by prime minister's office
articles.title: Israeli opposition chiefs denounce Netanyahu over ‘attempted coup’
articles.summary: Israeli opposition figures Yair Lapid and Yousef Jabareen condemned an alleged coup attempt following reports that outgoing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office orchestrated false complaints against Arab-Israeli Raam party members. Police arrested three individuals before releasing them due to unfounded evidence. Netanyahu previously accused Arab parties of electoral fraud after they secured a record number of seats in the October 27 election.
articles.description: Netanyahu subsequently accused Arab parties of electoral fraud after they gained a record number of seats

articles.headline: Foreign portfolio investors record highest ever monthly inflow in Indian equities
articles.title: FPIs stage record November comeback as domestic investors turn net sellers
articles.summary: Foreign portfolio investors recorded a net investment of eighty-nine thousand eight hundred fifty-six crore rupees in Indian equities during the first two weeks of November, reversing months of selling. National Securities Depository Limited data showed the dramatic turnaround followed previous outflows in September and October. Meanwhile, domestic institutional investors turned net sellers by offloading fifty-two thousand six hundred seven crore rupees as profit-booking accelerated after the Nifty index reclaimed the twenty-five thousand mark.
articles.description: Moderating momentum in global AI stocks, coupled with improving earnings prospects, particularly among large-cap companies, appears to have revived foreign investor interests.

articles.headline: Mahanadi Coalfields sets initial public offering price band at 129 to 136 rupees
articles.title: MCL fixes IPO price band at ₹129-136; Coal India to raise ₹9,000 cr.
articles.summary: Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd established a share price band for its upcoming initial public offering aimed at raising approximately 9,000 crore rupees. The offering consists entirely of an offer for sale of a ten percent stake by parent company Coal India. The bidding period for the Sambalpur-headquartered coal producer is scheduled to open on November 19 and close on November 23.
articles.description: The proposed listing is part of the government’s broader strategy to unlock value in Coal India’s subsidiaries through public listings and widen investor participation in the country’s coal sector

articles.headline: Prime Minister Andy Burnham set to sign new food trade agreement
articles.title: Faisal Islam: What's in the Brexit reset food deal and are there trade-offs?
articles.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham is scheduled to sign a Brexit reset agreement with the European Union on Friday, aiming to reduce food import costs and boost the economy by five billion pounds annually. The deal addresses post-Brexit border checks and paperwork for exporters like Marks and Spencer. While farming representatives expressed cautious optimism, critics raised concerns regarding regulatory alignment and the UK lacking a vote on EU food policies.
articles.description: EU minister Hamish Falconer insists Britain would have some influence on policy as part of a new deal.

articles.headline: Students protest as air pollution chokes New Delhi
articles.title: Students protest as air pollution chokes New Delhi
articles.description: Students have taken to the streets to demand accountability from authorities over toxic air pollution in New Delhi.

articles.headline: Street cricket with a legend then metro ride as William and Kate begin India visit
articles.title: Street cricket with a legend then metro ride as William and Kate begin India visit
articles.description: The Prince and Princess of Wales are visiting Mumbai for the Earthshot Prize this week, but started their trip with some fun outings.

articles.headline: Volodymyr Zelenskyy warns Starshield speed limits disrupt Ukrainian interceptor drone operations
articles.title: Why Starshield limits are hurting Ukraine against jet-powered drones
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that speed restrictions on SpaceX's Starshield military internet service are hampering drone operations against Russian forces. The limits reportedly cause interceptor drones to lose connection with operators at high speeds, reducing defense effectiveness against jet-powered drones. Zelenskyy urged American officials and SpaceX to remove the restrictions to protect lives and critical infrastructure ahead of winter.
articles.description: Ukraine's military has been relying on the internet service since December 2024 to intercept Russian drones.

articles.headline: Health minister confirms negative H5N1 tests for 23 persons in Cuddalore
articles.title: Samples of 23 persons tested H5N1 negative, says Health Minister
articles.summary: Health Minister K.G. Arunraj reported that samples from twenty-three poultry workers and veterinary staff associated with affected farms in Cuddalore tested negative for Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza. Speaking in Vellore town, Dr. Arunraj noted that twenty-seven samples were collected from fifty-four identified individuals. Although findings indicate the virus has not spread to humans, authorities intensified surveillance across the region and conducted twenty-seven medical camps within a ten-kilometer radius.
articles.description: At least 16 poultry farms in Cuddalore district affected by Avian Influenza; continuous surveillance being done by the Public Health Department, says Arunraj

articles.headline: Vijoo Krishnan urges united protests against union government agricultural policies
articles.title: Modi government favouring corporates at the cost of farmers: Vijoo Krishnan
articles.summary: All India Kisan Sabha national general secretary Vijoo Krishnan called on agricultural workers to intensify struggles against union government policies at the thirty-sixth national conference in Nalgonda. Mr. Krishnan alleged that economic agreements favor American interests and corporate groups while harming Indian agriculture. He criticized failures to support tenant farmers, demanded relief for drought-affected districts, and urged implementation of M.S. Swaminathan Commission recommendations.

articles.headline: Romelu Lukaku announces retirement from international football after sixteen years
articles.title: Belgium’s Romelu Lukaku retires from international football
articles.summary: Romelu Lukaku announced his retirement from international football after earning one hundred thirty-five caps and scoring ninety-four goals for Belgium over sixteen years. The thirty-three-year-old Fenerbahce forward, who featured in four World Cups and three European Championships, stated he was at peace with his decision. Technical director Simon Mignolet and the Red Devils paid tribute to his leadership, while Belgium prepares for their upcoming UEFA Nations League quarterfinals without him.
articles.description: Lukaku is Belgium's all-time leading goalscorer with 94 goals in 135 games and is fifth on men's all-time scoring list.

articles.headline: British comedian Russell Brand faces media reckoning following rape and assault conviction
articles.title: Russell Brand and the media that made him
articles.summary: The rape and sexual assault conviction of British comedian and actor Russell Brand has sparked a reckoning for the British entertainment industry and media institutions that maintained his platform despite allegations. Contributors including Dorothy Byrne and Caroline Frost discussed how influential outlets kept him visible. The episode also reviewed the closure of Russian newspaper Novaya Gazeta and examined advertising practices within Australia's gambling industry alongside expert commentators.
articles.description: A rape conviction for the British comedian and actor leads to a reckoning for the media that kept him in the spotlight.

articles.headline: Google Maps introduces AI-powered trip planning and itinerary features
articles.title: Google Maps can now create trip itineraries for you
articles.summary: Google is launching an AI trip-planning feature within its Ask Maps chatbot, allowing users to generate custom itineraries for outings. The tool provides real-time traffic, location hours, and travel logistics. Additionally, the update includes appointment-finding capabilities and expanded availability for Ask Maps, which is now rolling out to over 30 countries across Europe.
articles.description: Google is launching a new AI trip-planning feature for Maps that allows the app to create custom itineraries for you and provide real-time details about each stop. The update, which is rolling out to the Gemini-powered Ask Maps chatbot inside the app, lets you plan a one-day outing or a trip spanning several days. As […]

articles.headline: Jailed former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan requests medical treatment in letter
articles.title: Former Pakistan PM Imran Khan warns he may not 'return alive', seeks medical treatment for himself, wife
articles.summary: Jailed former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan warned in an open letter made public on November 16, 2026, that his health is deteriorating due to prolonged solitary confinement. Addressing top judges, Khan requested medical treatment for himself and his wife, Bushra Bibi, and called for the implementation of court orders concerning prison conditions and family access. The allegations could not be independently verified.
articles.description: Khan, the former cricketer-turned-politician and founder of the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf party, has been incarcerated since 2023 and faces more than 100 cases

articles.headline: Satellites monitor natural disasters but face delays transmitting data to earth
articles.title: Orbital computing could let scientists rent ‘brainpower’ in space
articles.summary: Earth observation satellites capture critical images of floods, submerged roads, and damaged infrastructure to assist emergency response teams. However, delays occur because recorded data must be transmitted to the earth and downloaded during satellite pass windows before ground users can analyse it for time-sensitive emergency operations and monitoring activities across oceans and agriculture.
articles.description: To bridge the gap between data being recorded by satellites and data being available to users on the ground, operators are pursuing a solution called in-orbit computing: the basic idea is to analyse some data onboard the satellite and only send back the most relevant information

articles.headline: Enterprises shift toward integrated AI platforms to scale autonomous workflows
articles.title: Building AI that can work across the enterprise
articles.summary: Businesses are moving away from isolated AI experiments toward integrated enterprise platforms to improve operational reliability. Executives from SAP and Infosys emphasize that successful scaling requires a unified data foundation, robust governance, and clear business metrics. This transition aims to evolve AI from a simple productivity tool into a strategic decision-making partner for organizations.
articles.description: For years, enterprises have approached AI as a series of discrete experiments. Now, as AI agents begin to move into the workflows that run the business, that model is starting to look inadequate. Organizations moving from isolated pilots toward AI agents and autonomous workflows are confronting a deeper challenge: rethinking how data, business processes, governance,…

articles.headline: British farmers hope UK-EU deal with revive post-Brexit trade
articles.title: British farmers hope UK-EU deal with revive post-Brexit trade
articles.description: Al Jazeera’s Charlie Angela speaks to a farmer in Sussex, who hopes a proposed UK-EU deal will ease trade barriers.

articles.headline: AI learning tool helps blind students excel in Malawi
articles.title: AI learning tool helps blind students excel in Malawi
articles.description: An artificial intelligence tool developed by a 25-year-old Malawian innovator is being used to help blind students.

articles.headline: Italian political leader criticizes colleague for remarks at summit in India
articles.title: Italian political leader’s speech in India draws criticism in his own country
articles.summary: Forza Italia national deputy secretary Deborah Bergamini criticized European Socialist Party Secretary General Giacomo Filibeck on November 15, 2026, for intervening in India's internal politics. Filibeck had supported Indian opposition leader Rahul Gandhi during the Bharat Summit in Hyderabad on November 14, using a Hindi slogan against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government. Bergamini stated that European representatives should not lecture India on democracy or interfere in friendly nations.
articles.description: Deborah Bergamini said Europeans should not give lessons on democracy to India, which has 970 million voters.

articles.headline: Algerian man sentenced to life in prison for Dublin school knife attack
articles.title: Man sentenced over 'horrific' attempted murder of three children
articles.summary: A 52-year-old man, Riad Bouchaker, was sentenced to life imprisonment in Dublin's Central Criminal Court on November 16, 2026, for the attempted murder of three children outside a primary school on November 23, 2023. Judge Tony Hunt noted the unprecedented nature of the attack, which also left creche worker Leanne Flynn with life-threatening injuries and sparked severe riots across Dublin involving historic deployments of police.
articles.description: Riad Bouchaker was sentenced after the attempted murder of three children in November 2023.

articles.headline: Jericho settlers harass Al Jazeera reporter after stealing Palestinian home
articles.title: Jericho settlers harass Al Jazeera reporter after stealing Palestinian home
articles.description: Israeli settlers who took over 8 homes in Jericho harassed Al Jazeera’s Nour Odeh.

articles.headline: International Cricket Council unveils qualification process for Los Angeles 2028 Olympics
articles.title: Which cricket teams can qualify for the LA 2028 Olympics and how?
articles.summary: The International Cricket Council has announced the qualification pathway for the Twenty20 cricket tournament at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Eight teams will compete in the men's and women's events, with spots determined by regional rankings and qualifying tournaments. Matches will be held at the Knight Riders Cricket Ground in Pomona, California, during July 2028.
articles.description: Six men's and six women's teams will compete for the medals in T20 format as cricket returns to the Olympics in 2028.

articles.headline: Cyclonic storm expected to bring heavy rain to coastal Andhra Pradesh
articles.title: Heavy rain likely in Chennai, neighbouring districts as cyclonic storm approaches Andhra coast
articles.summary: A deep depression in the Bay of Bengal is intensifying into a severe cyclonic storm, forecast to cross the Andhra Pradesh coast near Nellore and Tuni by Thursday. The Regional Meteorological Centre in Chennai expects heavy rainfall across coastal Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, and Karaikal, with wind speeds reaching 130 km/hour as the system makes landfall.
articles.description: For Wednesday (November 18) and Thursday (November 19), the RMC has forecast that heavy to very heavy rainfall is likely at isolated places over Chennai, Tiruvallur, and Chengalpattu districts

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh government proposes Investment Protection Act to boost investor confidence
articles.title: Andhra’s proposed Investment Protection Act seeks to shield investors from policy U-turns
